Former Maldives Foreign Minister **Abdulla Shahid** (MDP) was arrested on sexual abuse charges. He was **President of the 76th UN General Assembly (2021-22)**. Maldives President: **Mohamed Muizzu**.

Students blockaded dozens of high schools and universities across **France** over education reforms; Education Minister: Edouard Geffray. South Korea and **Türkiye** (President **Erdoğan**) signed nuclear and defence pacts in Seoul.
Gunmen killed two police guarding a **polio** vaccination team in north-west Pakistan. **Pakistan and Afghanistan** are the only countries where wild polio is still endemic.
An Indian was killed when two helicopters (Fishtail Air, Air Dynasty) collided near **Everest Base Camp**, Nepal.
**Prema Rawat** (Uttarakhand) hit the **fastest fifty in women's T20s** — **14 balls** — against Hyderabad in the Senior Women's T20 Trophy at Pune.
Youth Olympic Games (Dakar): judoka **Khushbu Rajakbhai** won **silver** (63kg) and swimmer **Dhinidhi Desinghu** **bronze** in the 100m freestyle (56.27s).
Squash: **Velavan Senthilkumar** won the **$35,000 Czech Open** in Brno (his 12th PSA Tour title), beating top seed Greg Lobban.
Chennai Open: wild cards **Maaya Rajeshwaran** (17, Coimbatore) and **Vaishnavi Adkar** (21) won their first WTA Tour-level matches.
**Punjab Kings** (coach **Ricky Ponting**) are close to getting **Hardik Pandya** from Mumbai Indians in exchange for **Arshdeep Singh** and Vishnu Vinod before IPL 2027.

Asian Champions Trophy semis move to **Mohali** (Olympian **Balbir Singh** stadium; the league was at the Olympian **Surjit** stadium, Jalandhar): India vs **Korea**, Malaysia vs Japan. India had beaten Korea 8-0.

India's ODIs in New Zealand (5 matches, captain **Shubman Gill**): Gill is the second batter after **Rohit Sharma** with more than one ODI double hundred; Rohit holds the highest ODI score (**264**); **Virat Kohli** has the most ODI centuries (**55**).
India's **first overseas Test win** came at **Dunedin** (Carisbrook) in **Feb 1968** under **Tiger Pataudi**; India then won the series in New Zealand **3-1**, its first overseas series win.
ODI ball rule (since 2025): two new balls are used until the **34th over**; then one ball is chosen for the remaining overs.
India-A drew the second 'Test' with New Zealand-A (Yashasvi Jaiswal 155*, Yash Rathod 100*); Ranji: Gujarat's Urvil Patel 210*, Tamil Nadu's Pradosh Ranjan Paul 208.
**Lakshya Sen** beat Indonesia's **Jonatan Christie** 21-17, 21-10 in the Hylo Open final, his first title of 2026 and second Hylo Open.

UK-Japan study (*Current Biology*): the direction a **Euhadra** snail's shell coils is set by the **mother's myosin gene** (a 'maternal effect'): one S (sinistral) copy in the mother gives left-handed offspring.

**CSIR-NEERI**'s green crackers emit about **30% less particulate matter**. Types: **SWAS** (water releaser), **STAR** (thermite-based) and **SAFAL** (minimal aluminium); packs carry the CSIR-NEERI logo and a QR code.
**CSIR-NEERI** (National Environmental Engineering Research Institute) is in **Nagpur**.

In Delhi's **Mustafabad** constituency, **16 of 20** BJP-appointed booth-level agents (BLAs) denied filing the **787** Form 7 deletion applications (of **1,021** total) that listed them as 'objectors'; all target Muslim electors.

SC assured excluded Delhi voters they won't face prosecution, but advocate **Prashant Bhushan** said ECI still forces pre-existing voters purged in SIR to file **Form 6** (meant for new voters) instead of Form 8; matter listed **19 November**.

ECI has split **Form 6** and the **SIR Declaration** into two separate steps (each needing its own OTP/e-Sign) in its online portal for States where SIR is complete, after Election Commissioners flagged the combined form as unapproved by the Law Ministry.

SC sought the Centre's response on pleas challenging **Section 16** of the **Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023**, which gives the CEC/ECs lifelong immunity from prosecution even after retirement.

SC (Justice **P.S. Narasimha**): laws penalising **more than two children** for contesting local-body elections (e.g. **Javed v. State of Haryana**, 2003) have 'lost their relevance' as India's **Total Fertility Rate fell from 3.02 to 1.9** (replacement rate is 2.1), violating **Article 21**.
The SC verdict noted India's share of persons aged **60 and above rose from 8.3% (2014) to 9.7% (2024)**, and is projected to reach nearly **15% by 2036**.

A 7-judge SC Bench (CJI **Surya Kant**) held that a **cess levied as a surcharge on sales tax** stays within a State's taxing power under **Entry 54, List II**, reaffirming the 1975 ruling **S. Kodar v. State of Kerala**.

Delhi's 24-hour AQI rose to **377** ('very poor') on 5 Nov, up from **350**; stubble burning's share in Delhi's PM2.5 **doubled from 8.2% to 16.28%** between Tuesday and Wednesday, per the Union Ministry of Earth Sciences.
CPCB's AQI bands: **201-300 'poor'**, **301-400 'very poor'**, **401-450 'severe'**, **451-500 'severe plus'** (scale of 0-500).

The **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)** in NCR issued show-cause notices to Senior Superintendents of Police and Deputy Commissioners of **five Punjab districts** for not complying with its stubble-burning orders.

Union Cabinet approved a **two-year additional engagement period** for Agniveers: the **75%** not retained after the initial 4-year term can now serve 2 more years (with higher pay) before being considered for regular enrolment; earlier only up to **25%** per batch were retained. Announced by CDS **Gen. N.S. Raja Subramani**.

Union Cabinet extended the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for **Fast-Track Special Courts** (incl. exclusive **POCSO** courts) by **5 years (to 31 March 2031)**; outlay **₹3,788.04 crore** (Centre ₹2,353.15 cr + States ₹1,434.89 cr) from the **Nirbhaya Fund**; **779** FTSCs (incl. 399 POCSO-exclusive) have disposed **4,02,457** cases since **2019**; plan to scale up to **850** FTSCs.

India secured preliminary investment commitments worth **$400 billion** across renewables (green hydrogen, energy storage, transmission), announced by Union Minister **Pralhad Joshi** at the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo.

Union Cabinet approved the **VISTAR** scheme (**Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics and Research**) with an outlay of **₹4,371 crore** (FY2026-27 to 2030-31) to overhaul India's statistical ecosystem, in three components including an economic census.

Union Cabinet approved a **₹14,500-crore** Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme (2026-27 to 2030-31) for **92 GWh** of new grid-scale energy storage (60 GWh hydro pumped storage + 30 GWh battery storage + 2 GWh other), to help reach **411 GWh** of storage capacity by **2031-32**; total project investment **₹97,600 crore**.

Union Cabinet approved a **₹2,814-crore** capital-expenditure support scheme (5 years) for domestic **lithium and nickel** processing facilities, announced by Coal & Mines Minister **G. Kishan Reddy**.
Gold prices rose **3%** on 4 Nov as the US dollar index slipped to a **5-week low of 101.3** ahead of the US midterm results.

On 4 Nov, Sensex gained **383 points (0.5%)** to **77,301** and Nifty rose **149 points (0.6%)** to **23,960** — a fifth straight day of gains; India's VIX ('fear gauge') is up **65.4%** year-to-date despite easing from its late-October high of 17.

Mercedes-Benz announced a fresh **₹200-crore** investment in India (total **₹3,200 crore**) and launched the electric **GLC SUV** (from **₹78.5 lakh**, 711 km range); Chairman **Ola Källenius** said India will source more tech/components for Mercedes' global operations.

In the 4 Nov US midterms, Democrats won control of both chambers: at least **237 of 435** House seats (analysts project 250+) and at least **54 of 100** Senate seats (incl. 2 independents), flipping **7** Republican-held Senate seats — **Texas, Ohio, South Carolina, Iowa, Maine, North Carolina, Kansas**.

US midterm 'firsts': **James Talarico** — first Democrat to win Texas statewide office in decades (beating AG **Ken Paxton**); **Adam Hamilton** — first Democratic Kansas senator since **1932**; **Annie Andrews** — first Democratic South Carolina senator since **1998**; **Abdul El-Sayed** (Michigan) — first Muslim elected to the US Senate.

Democrats now hold at least **28 of 50** US governorships (up from 24); **Gina Hinojosa** became Texas's first Democratic Governor since **1995**, unseating **Greg Abbott**; **Keisha Lance Bottoms** became Georgia's first Black woman Governor.

President **Donald Trump** congratulated Democrats on the result, conceded the **Iran war** 'played a part' in Republican losses, but denied personal responsibility and warned he would **veto** Democratic bills.

Iran's Revolutionary Guards said **four oil tankers** caught fire after striking naval mines while trying to cross the **Strait of Hormuz** without authorisation; two more vessels were halted and a US-made drone was shot down.
The US Treasury imposed fresh sanctions on firms in **India and Türkiye** for allegedly aiding Iran, under its **'Operation Economic Outcast'** campaign.

A *Nature* study (airborne CO2 readings, 2010-2024, lead author **Luciana Vanni Gatti**) found the **Amazon rainforest is now a net carbon source, not a sink**: wildfires caused it to emit **1.17 billion tonnes** more carbon than it absorbed; in the El Niño year **2024**, **38%** of deforestation was fire-caused.

Amazon deforestation data (2010-24): mining area up **272%**, pasture area up **19%**, soybean plantations up **193%**; dry-season rainfall fell **17%** (1979-2018). A separate Indian study projects the country's vegetation carbon storage could nearly **double (97%)** by 2100, chiefly in Rajasthan, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.
**Virat Kohli** became the first player in ODI history with a batting average of **50+ across all four SENA nations**: South Africa (76.38), England (51.48), New Zealand (51.53), Australia (50.03).

India beat New Zealand by **5 wickets** (DLS method) in the 1st ODI in Auckland to lead the 5-match series **1-0**; **Kohli** (74, on the eve of his 38th birthday) and **Anshul Kamboj** (Player of the Match, 2/22 with 46 dot balls) starred.

Former hockey captain **M.M. Somaya**'s **1980 Moscow Olympics gold medal** — India's last Olympic hockey gold — was stolen from his Bengaluru home, along with other medals and jewellery; Somaya played 3 Olympics (1980, 1984, 1988) and won the **Arjuna Award in 1985**.
**Nirmala Lakshman**, Director of The Hindu Group, won the **Sharjah Award** for Best International Non-Fiction Book for *'The Tamils: A Portrait of a Community'* (Aleph Book Company, Jan 2025).

India thrashed Korea **8-1** in the Asian Champions Trophy hockey semifinal in Mohali to reach its **6th ACT final in 7 editions**, where it will meet **Japan** (which beat Malaysia 5-3 on shootout) in the first-ever India-Japan ACT final.

**Kimi Antonelli** (Mercedes) became the **youngest Formula 1 World Champion ever** — **20 years, 68 days** — beating Sebastian Vettel's record (23y 134d) by finishing third in Mexico City; he is the first Italian F1 champion since **Alberto Ascari (1953)** and drives car No. **12**, like his idol **Ayrton Senna**.
**Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu** became the first Indian to win a **wushu** medal at the **Youth Olympic Games**, taking bronze in the women's Changquan combined event in Dakar.
**P.B. Abhinandh and Divyanshi Bhowmick** became the World No. 1 pair in the under-19 mixed-doubles badminton rankings.

ECI announced the annual **Special Summary Revision (SSR)** of rolls for **6** States/UTs (Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Odisha, Sikkim, Chandigarh, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu) where SIR is complete; draft rolls **30 Nov**, final **21 Jan 2027**; Aadhaar in Forms 6/8 stays **voluntary**.
The SSR was earlier announced (15 Oct) for **17** States/UTs including poll-bound **Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Manipur and Goa**.

Activists **Anjali Bhardwaj and Amrita Johri** sought FIRs over alleged **Form 7 forgery** in Delhi's Mustafabad, and a full audit of Form 7 filings; **₹47.56 lakh** names were dropped from Delhi's draft roll (published 31 Aug); final roll deadline pushed to **22 December**.

ECI restored oversight of its **IT wing** (headed by **Seema Khanna**) under a Deputy Election Commissioner, reversing a July order that had let her report directly to the Commission, after ECs **S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi** objected.

Elaborating its 'arrest begins at detention' ruling, the SC held any person **detained beyond 24 hours** must be released immediately on production before a Magistrate, who must record the **actual time of detention**; only travel time to court is excluded from the 24-hour count.

A 3-storey **unauthorised** building under construction collapsed in old Delhi's **Chawri Bazar**, killing 2 and trapping others; Delhi Police had flagged the illegal construction as early as **15 June**; it is Delhi's **3rd major building collapse since 6 September**, after 13 deaths.

On the Danger-in-the-sewer editorial: **859** sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank jobs (2014-2025), **332** across 18 States/UTs (2021-26); SC's *Dr. Balram Singh* (2023) raised death compensation to **₹30 lakh** per worker.

DRDO successfully flight-tested the indigenous quasi-ballistic missile **Pralay** from **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island**, Odisha, on 5 Nov, in a user-evaluation trial clearing the way for its induction into the armed forces.

The government clarified **Agnipath is not rolled back**: the 25% retained after 4 years continue as before, while the remaining 75% get a second 2-year engagement, after which all willing and fit Agniveers can join the regular cadre with **protected seniority**.

NPCI told the SC that **'zero MDR' on all UPI transactions is unsustainable**; the new **0.4% MDR** applies only to Person-to-Merchant transactions **above ₹2,000** (about **4%** of merchant transactions); P2P and small P2M stay free. UPI processed **24.51 billion** transactions worth **₹29.82 lakh crore** in August 2026 alone.

**CERT-In** issued 'AI Security Auditing Guidelines' for **agentic AI** systems that plan tasks, use tools and delegate work on their own, calling for audits of permission overreach, unsafe task delegation and emergency 'stop' mechanisms.

CERT-In named a hacking group, **'Crafty Falcon'** (linked to China), that used AI tools (ARTEX, PentAGI, Cairn, CyberStrikeAI) to breach Indian non-bank lenders, fintechs and crypto exchanges 'at machine speed'.

The Centre told the SC it is weighing a special committee to review the **UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026**, stayed by the SC in **January 2026** as 'too sweeping'; the older **2012 Regulations** continue to apply.

ISRO chief **V. Narayanan** confirmed navigation satellite **NVS-03** (launched 30 Oct) is 'fully healthy' after its engine fired for **6,400 seconds** to reach circular orbit; in-orbit payload testing is under way.

Israel's Arab-majority **Joint List (11 seats)** and **Ra'am (8 seats)** backed **Gadi Eisenkot** (not PM Netanyahu) to form the next government after the inconclusive 27 Oct election; President **Isaac Herzog** will give the mandate, with **28 days** (extendable by 14) to form a government.
Iran reported **two more** tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the **Strait of Hormuz**; the UK's UKMTO reported a tanker hit by projectiles off Qatar.

On US midterm day, President **Trump** announced the US will stop its roughly **$4-billion** annual military aid to Israel by year-end, citing political costs after a candidate's anti-aid campaign plank helped flip Michigan.

US Vice-President **J.D. Vance** blamed the **Iran war** for the Republican midterm defeat ('The reason we lost is the war'), positioning himself as the front-runner for the **2028** Republican presidential nomination.

NPPA capped trade margins at **30%** on **137** non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs, cutting prices of nearly **900** brands by **70-93%** (e.g. Palbociclib: ₹40,000 to ₹2,720); but **194 of 1,024** analysed brands saw **no** price cut.

A *Nature Medicine* global study of **6.1 million** people in 118 countries found women report more pain than men at **all 11** body sites studied — **83%** higher for facial pain, **74%** for headaches, **60%** for abdominal pain.

Census 2027 will be India's **first fully digital Census**; door-to-door enumeration begins **1 December** in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab and Goa (completed already in Ladakh/snow-bound J&K, HP, Uttarakhand); ~**34 lakh** enumerators will use a phone app, tracked in real time via the **Census Management and Monitoring System (CMMS)**.

India beat Japan **4-1** in the Asian Champions Trophy hockey final in Mohali to retain the title — its **6th ACT crown in 7 editions**; midfielder **Hardik Singh** played his **200th** international match in the tournament.
**Cristiano Ronaldo** (41) retired from international football, leaving as Portugal's all-time (and world-record) scorer with **146 goals in 234 matches**; he won Euro 2016 with Portugal.

Delhi-Services Ranji Group-C match ended in a draw: **Rajat Paliwal** (116) and **Mohit Ahlawat** (142) powered Services; **Yash Dhull** (104*) and **Priyansh Arya** rescued Delhi after being set 320 in 54 overs.

**Chennai Super Kings** traded for all-rounders **Liam Livingstone and Jack Edwards** from Sunrisers Hyderabad, giving up pacers **Khaleel Ahmed and Nathan Ellis**, ahead of IPL 2027 — CSK's first trade under new coach **Zaheer Khan**.

SC (Justice **Ujjal Bhuyan**): an **arrest begins the moment** an official **touches** a person to restrain their liberty, starting the **24-hour** clock under **Article 22(2)** then and there, not from the time of formal arrest.

A **tokamak** confines fusion plasma magnetically in a ring; the concept came from Soviet physicists **Igor Tamm and Andrei Sakharov** (1950s). **ITER** (7 members: China, EU, India, Japan, South Korea, Russia, US) is being built at **Cadarache, France**. India's tokamaks — **ADITYA/ADITYA-U** (1989/2017) and **SST-1** (2013) — are at the **Institute for Plasma Research, Gandhinagar**.
China's **EAST** tokamak (Hefei) sustained high-confinement plasma for **1,066 seconds** in Jan 2025, a world record; no tokamak has yet produced **net commercial energy**.

ECI directed that voters marked **ASDD (Absent/Shifted/Dead/Duplicate)** in **7** States/UTs under SIR (Delhi, Maharashtra, Haryana, Andhra Pradesh, Jharkhand, Telangana, Nagaland) can resubmit their **enumeration form** (not Form 6) to get re-included in the rolls; follows a SC query during the Oct 28 Bhardwaj-Johri hearing.

Mustafabad (Delhi) Form-7 case: the ERO sought an FIR against BJP booth-level agent Chandra Shekhar Nainwal; DEO scrutiny found **36 of 37** Form-7 deletion applications "fabricated" (only 1 true); **Section 31 of the RP Act** invoked for false declaration.

Editorial: Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh's plan to use voter ID + biometrics to verify welfare beneficiaries (Rahul Gandhi called it "rights theft") contradicts the **SC's May 27 judgment** on Bihar SIR, which held ECI's citizenship enquiry is "limited" and its consequence confined to electoral rolls alone, not welfare eligibility.

SC clarified its **March 11, 2026** OBC non-creamy-layer judgment (excluding parental salary/agri income from the income test) does **not** require retrospective revision of service allocations or seniority across recruitment years; Civil Services Exam 2025 results (declared March 6) stand, with the creamy-layer principle only governing fresh allocation.

Gauhati HC quashed the **NSA detention** of Assam land-rights activist Pranab Doley (Greater Kaziranga Land and Human Rights Protection Committee), held since July over protests against a luxury hotel near Kaziranga National Park; released after **118 days** in custody.

SC termed Delhi's vehicle/construction bans "old, tried and **failed tools**" for pollution control and asked if the Centre/CAQM had any scientific alternative; Delhi's AQI crossed **400** (GRAP-III) hours after the hearing; CJI Surya Kant said curbing pollution needs public behaviour change, not just court orders.

SC (CJI Surya Kant) said **cybercriminals** "have no space in society" and jails "are only meant for them" while rejecting a bail plea; cited I4C data showing digital-arrest complaints fell from **1,23,672** (2024) to **58,249** (2025) to **16,377** (H1 2026); e-Zero FIR mechanism functional in **19** States.
SC declined to suspend journalist **Tarun Tejpal**'s 10-year sentence in the 2013 Goa rape case (Bombay HC's August verdict overturning his trial-court acquittal), but agreed to hear his appeal.

SC sought responses from news portal **NewsClick** and editor Prabir Purkayastha on an ED plea against a Delhi HC order quashing a money-laundering case over alleged **₹9.59 crore** FDI-rule violations (from Worldwide Media Holdings LLC, US, in FY 2018-19).

SC issued notice to Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee office-bearers on a contempt plea over a (now-deleted) social-media post against CJI Surya Kant, saying "the independence of the judiciary is not a matter of political convenience."

Jharkhand HC quashed the State's cancellation of the **JSSC-CGL** recruitment exam and ordered reinstatement, with continuous service, of candidates selected under advertisement 10/2023; held the government gave no concrete evidence of systemic irregularities.

SC settled a **1966** Bhakra-Beas energy dues dispute: Himachal Pradesh will get **11,973 million units** of power from Punjab and Haryana over 20 years (per the 2011 SC verdict fixing shares at HP 7.19%, Punjab 51.80%, Haryana 37.51%, Chandigarh 3.50%), with no cash payment required.

Delhi Police arrested 3 contractors (Siraj, Tajuddin, Furkan) over the Chawri Bazar building collapse, booked under **BNS Section 105** (culpable homicide not amounting to murder); 4 workers remained missing on the second day of rescue operations.

Three major fires broke out at Delhi commercial sites ahead of Deepavali (Gandhi Nagar garment warehouse, Karol Bagh's Gaffar Market, a Saket car showroom); DFS received **78** calls, **15** rescued, **7** injured.
A fire at an **Oil India Limited (OIL)** installation in Dibrugarh, Assam killed 1 and injured 6 contractor staff.

Op-ed on Panna/Chhatarpur (M.P.) displacement by the Majhgaya dam, Runjh dam and **Ken-Betwa river-linking project** (a 96.7-metre dam near Daudhan on the Ken): about **8,000 Adivasi families** across 22 villages affected; **2.3 million trees** to be felled; FRA Section 4(5) rights-recognition not completed before eviction; activist Divya Ahirwar, jailed since Sept 27 on a fabricated charge, granted HC bail.

Ground report on the **Siang Upper Multipurpose Project** (11,000 MW, declared a national project in 2008): Adi community opposition via the Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum; China's under-construction **Medog dam** on the Yarlung-Tsangpo (which feeds the Brahmaputra) is cited to justify speeding up the project; Article 371(h) of the Constitution (special provisions for Arunachal/Nagaland) referenced.

NC chief Farooq Abdullah ruled out a party split after meeting **17** dissident MLAs; Speaker Om Birla accepted Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi's resignation from the party and his Lok Sabha seat, effective November 3.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah set a "hat-trick" target of over **65** of Uttarakhand's **70** Assembly seats for the BJP at the State's 26th Foundation Day event.

Congress renewed its demand to scrap Agnipath, alleging a shortfall of over **2 lakh** soldiers and that **1.5 lakh** recruited candidates' joining was halted; alleged over **40** Agniveer suicides — a day after the Cabinet's 2-year-extension clarification.

CBSE's 2027 Class 10 and 12 board exams will begin **February 16** (Class 10 ends March 9, Class 12 ends April 9); Class 10 has 83 subjects and Class 12 has 121 subjects on offer; **26.5 lakh** Class 10 and **19.8 lakh** Class 12 students have registered.

Centre mandated weekly rice/paddy stock declaration (6 categories) by traders on the Food Stock Portal under **Sections 6 and 7 of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955**; let 5 southern States (AP, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana) impose stock limits till Jan 31, 2027; doubled the OMSS e-auction target for 2026-27 from 25 to **50 lakh tonnes**.

Chennai-based TB nonprofit **REACH** won the **Kochon Prize 2026**, the first Indian civil-society organisation to do so; shared with Kenya's Centre for Health Solutions and the Marshall Islands TB Control Program.

Indian GM **V. Pranav** (20, Chennai) won the Open title at the FIDE World Junior Blitz Championship in Al Ain (10.5/13 points), having already won the World Junior Classical title; he also took rapid silver at the same event.

Sensex rose 2.17% (1,718 pts) to **81,028.02** and Nifty 2.01% to **25,030.35** (highest since March 2) on Nov 6 — the Nifty's biggest weekly rally of 2026 (+6.8%) — even as the Nasdaq-100 fell **6.36%** on Nov 5 (wiping ~$2.53 trillion), on AI-infrastructure-spending fears after the US midterms; the rupee hit a 6-month high of **93.89**/$.

Brent crude fell **16%** this week (steepest since the pandemic) after Iran opened the Strait of Hormuz for transit to a few countries, including India, reviving hopes of a US-Iran war resolution; Iran's Revolutionary Guards separately said two more tankers caught fire in the Strait.
Mumbai NCLT declared Videocon Industries' former promoter **Venugopal Dhoot** "bankrupt" over a **₹12,668 crore** default to SBI, admitting the lender's petition and appointing a bankruptcy trustee.
NPCI set up a wholly owned subsidiary, **NPCI Tech Solutions Ltd (NTSL)**, to focus on AI, blockchain and GCC services beyond its core payments mandate; Vishal Kanvaty named MD & CEO.

Govt approved 12 more projects under the **Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS)**, taking total approvals to 118 and committed investment to **₹77,051 crore** (~30% above the original ₹59,350-crore target); the biggest is a ₹3,546-crore copper-foil facility by Indo Asia Copper Ltd in Amreli, Gujarat.
India-born Democratic Socialist **Nithya Raman** was elected Mayor of Los Angeles, defeating incumbent Karen Bass **52%-48%**.

Israel: Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot said he expects President Isaac Herzog to give him the government-formation mandate on Sunday; Opposition partner Avigdor Liberman lifted his veto on ultra-Orthodox military-service demands but still refuses an alliance with Israeli-Arab parties.

The **13th ICAPP General Assembly** (Seoul, Nov 4-6; 83 Asian political parties) adopted the "Seoul Declaration", stressing non-interference, peaceful dispute settlement and adherence to the UN Charter amid rising unilateral actions.
The US recorded **5,182** confirmed measles cases this year, the highest since 1991; measles was declared eliminated in the US in 2000.

Mohammed Shami retired from Test cricket with **229 wickets in 64 matches** over a 13-year career (debut vs West Indies, Eden Gardens, Nov 6, 2013); best figures 5/28 (Johannesburg, 2018); last Test was the 2023 WTC final at the Oval.

Mitchell Starc reached **460 wickets in 110 Tests** (avg 25.97) — the most by any left-arm pacer in history — having passed Wasim Akram's 414 during the 2025-26 Ashes; his 2025 calendar year yielded 55 wickets in 11 Tests at an average of 17.32.

India won its first-ever **aquatics medals at the Youth Olympics** (Dakar 2026, the 4th edition since 2010): Dhinidhi Desinghu won bronze in both 100m freestyle (56.27s, a new Indian women's best) and 200m freestyle (2:02.28s); Tirthank Pegu won bronze in men's 200m butterfly (2:01.25s), India's first male swimming medal at the Games.
Tanvi Patri won badminton silver at the Dakar Youth Olympics, losing the final to World junior champion Zhang Yi Xin of China 21-15, 13-21, 24-26.
